candidates.summary: India's GST collections in October reached ₹2.31 lakh crore, reflecting a 22.9% year-on-year increase. Strong consumption trends are indicated by rising passenger car sales and record digital payments. Power consumption also surged nearly 22% compared to last year, further emphasizing economic strength. Despite a high inflation rate of 5.5%, demand has remained robust, supporting growth forecasts. Analysts suggest this growth aligns with leading indicators of a consumption-driven economy.
candidates.title: GST collections jump 22.9% to Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October as festive demand beats high inflation and interest rates

candidates.summary: People across India are protesting peacefully, contrasting with violent agitations seen in other countries. Elections help to channel frustrations and enable citizens to express their concerns. As a result, the political landscape remains dynamic and participatory, fostering a sense of empowerment.
candidates.title: One nation, many opportunities: Why India's many elections may be keeping protests peaceful
